title: apricity import --markers and --reset-markers in apricity-cli (file mode)
description:
## Intent
The command, file mode.

## Scope
- `crates/apricity-cli/src/import.rs` + `Cmd::Import`: `apricity import --markers <FILE> [--sample AUDIO] [--beat-offset N] [--dry-run] [--library DIR]` and `apricity import --reset-markers <AUDIO> [--library DIR]` (exactly one of the two).
- Sample resolution: `.asd` → the audio beside it (file name minus `.asd`); `.alc` → its file reference (relative, then absolute), else `--sample`, else an error suggesting `--sample`.
- File mode: rewrite the manifest's `annotations.markers` (drop your `warp` markers, add the new ones with `source: user`), preserving every other byte of meaning; write atomically; re-read through `apricity_score::Clip::from_json` so the stored result is validated before replacing the file.
- `--help` with an example of the round trip; report and error texts exactly as the scenarios say.

## Verify
`safe-run.sh -- cargo test -p apricity-cli --test daw_cli` (file-mode import and reset scenarios green) and `./target/debug/apricity import --help`.

Commit: `feat(<this id>): apricity import --markers and --reset-markers`.

---
**Toolchain:** every Bash call starts with `export PATH=$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=2`; run builds and tests under the watchdog: `safe-run.sh -- <command>` (6 GB / 20 min cap; do not edit it). At most two Rust-building agents at once.
**Protocol:** specs first (write the scenario, watch it fail, then code); keep a running log with `kbs comment` (decisions, problems, attempts, outcomes); paste the tail of **Verify** before asking for review; never commit, push or close (the reviewer does, after re-running Verify). Never write the DAW's brand name anywhere.
